tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Total amino acids in the hydrolysate (g/100 g) from processing of Atlantic mackerel (10,000–200 Da retentate). Analyses were conducted in duplicate.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Purification of antibacterial peptides from hydrolysate of whole mackerel.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Peptide fragments identified by MS/MS analysis, with more than 75% homology to antibacterial proteins from CAMP. Peptide sequence properties and their related precursor proteins were obtained from ExPASY and Scaffold (protein-threshold probability > 95%) analyses, respectively.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: MIC of the synthetic peptide (AMGAP) expressed in mM. ND, non-determined.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Bacterial targets used for screening of antibacterial activity from hydrolysate. BHI, Brain Heart Infusion; LB, Luria-Bertani; TSB, Tryptone Soy Broth; YE, Yeast Extract; YEG, Yeast Extract Glucose.
footnotes: † Laboratoire de Microbiologie Alimentaire (LMA) strain collection (Laval University, QC, Canada).
